correctness.rationale: Every binary order-eight orientable cycle chooses at most one edge per each of 120 nonpalindromic reversal pairs and has balanced seven-bit de Bruijn degrees. The signed-incidence argument and 16-palindromic-orbit parity yield a perfect matching in the 240-port graph of cost equal to omitted pairs. A packaged integer 240-vector has sum 28 and exactly satisfies all 330 edge inequalities; thus at least 28 pairs omitted, period at most 92. A packaged 92-letter cyclic witness is checked for all 92 distinct nonpalindromic reversal-disjoint factors. Python standard-library verifier replayed successfully from actual packaged paths. No inference from finite samples to other orders.
